body: can I add left nav to some of the docs

Thx for offering to help, @ajitsinghkaler!

This is actually an issue/limitation of our infrastructure (not related to docs content). So, not a good issue for someone that is not familiar with our docs infrastructure/tooling.

I saw you volunteered to help out with a few other issues too, so I am sure one of those will be more suitable for you to contribute. Thx again for stepping up!

##
(BTW, as a work-around, one can have a ToC in a doc without it appearing in the SideNav by adding it to `navigation.json` with `hidden: true` ([example][1].)

[1]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/ca1ff3ea11ef1b32bfff1ee365480fcc71c7119e/aio/content/navigation.json#L58
As mentioned above, I am afraid it is not a good issue for a first contribution, so I suggest you start somewhere else. But if you insist, I won't stand in your way 😛
